# Disruption Joe

Disruption Joe helps organizations turn scattered AI use into better work, shared practice, useful judgment, visible progress, and compounding business value.

Primary site spine:

- Home: https://disruptionjoe.com/
- Services: https://disruptionjoe.com/services
- Method: https://disruptionjoe.com/method
- AI Activation Playbook: https://disruptionjoe.com/playbook
- AI Enablement Architecture: https://disruptionjoe.com/enablement
- AI Accelerated Thinking: https://disruptionjoe.com/thinking
- AI Capability Soundcheck: https://disruptionjoe.com/soundcheck
- About: https://disruptionjoe.com/about
- Contact: https://disruptionjoe.com/contact

Positioning:

Disruption Joe is not a prompt-training shop, automation vendor, implementation firm, or generic AI speaker. The work is about AI adoption through designed experiences: sessions, methods, activation systems, and interactive environments that help people change how they think, work, decide, and collaborate with AI.
